features.note: No structural regression: the drive blade presents its bright up-swept airfoil face while the adjacent blades counter-tilt into dark undersides — never parallel at 30%. Held at the threshold rather than above it because the material change hurts the read: the two counter-rotated blades are now crushed to featureless black voids, so counter-rotation rests almost entirely on the drive blade's silhouette against them.

Unchanged and strong: plated stub protrudes from a collared boss on the frame right face with ~40-50 mm free spindle before the black clamp plate; the orange body hangs offset on the shaft, never flush. Anti-rotation strap descends to a strap foot on the frame with a legible plated hex bolt and washer. Plated shaft/bolt material read supports the feature.

Off-white indicator disc with a bold dark pointer sits on the actuator head on the shaft axis at a position consistent with 30% travel. Printed 0-90 arc still absent — explicitly deferred to the surface pass, not penalized here. No regression.

No regression: channel frame keeps real ~0.13 m depth, flange rings on both faces with discrete fastener heads, and visible wall thickness at the interior opening. The flange top faces now carry a cool sky-gradient sheen that is the scene's best galvanized-metal cue.

Assembly intact: plated vertical tie rod (now a convincing bright smooth metal), three crank blocks with pin studs, unequal block spacing betraying articulation. Marginal because the carried structural correction was NOT applied: all three crank arms still tilt parallel in screen space, while blade 2 (-theta) should oppose blades 1 and 3 (+theta). Kinematic coherence remains approximate.

important_features.note: Blade-edge EPDM bulbs read as discrete matte near-black rounded strips along the blade long edges — correct rubber flatness, no specular hotspot. Jamb strips on the interior left face now show a faint edge boundary separating them from the frame tone, but the upper interior still crushes into shadow — the carried jamb-separation correction is only partially achieved.
Clean light rectangular label plate on the orange front face at plausible proportions; printed spec text is a surface-pass item, not penalized. Unchanged.

Dark cable exits below the actuator and droops with a verifiable curved bend to the floor left of the CONTROL DE EQUIPO panel — a catenary, not a rod. Dim against the dark floor and partially clipped by the UI panel, but legible.

defects: Hero galvanized surface fails the bare-metal read: the drive blade's curved face renders as near-Lambertian bright white with a soft diffuse gradient and NO reflected environment structure despite strong curvature in a dark room — it reads as matte white-painted plastic, far brighter than the frame that shares the galv_steel family (#aeb4b8, metalness 0.95). A 0.95-metal surface here should mirror darker room content and sit in the frame's value family.

Zero roughness variation anywhere in the galvanized family: frame faces and blade skin are perfectly uniform — no spangle, streaking, or mottling breaks the CG uniformity the materials gate explicitly requires.
Carried defect NOT fixed: the faint dashed diagonal line still crosses the frame's lower-right corner near the strap foot and continues onto the floor — reads as a stray helper/edge line, not a part.
Carried defect NOT fixed: all three crank arms on the side linkage still tilt parallel; blade 2's crank should be opposed to blades 1 and 3 per the opposed-blade signs.

Value floor crushed: the two counter-rotated blades, the EPDM seals in shade, and the black plastic clamp/strap all collapse to near-black voids with no readable shading, so rubber vs plastic vs shadowed metal cannot be distinguished in the lower half of the opening.

Jamb seals only partially separated from interior shadow: a faint strip edge now reads on the lower interior left face, but the upper interior still merges seal and shade (carried correction incomplete).

Single-view ambiguity (recorded per gate contract): metallic response of the frame is only verifiable on flange top faces from this one view; no grazing/look-dev view was provided to confirm the galvanized read under a second light angle.
corrections: Material Realism Reset on galv_steel as applied to the blades: verify the blade meshes actually use the galvanized PBR (color #aeb4b8, metalness 0.95, roughness ~0.45) AND receive the scene environment map — the curved blade face must pick up dark room reflections and land in the same value family as the frame, not render near-white diffuse.
Add subtle roughness variation to the galvanized family (roughness map or procedural mottling ~0.35-0.55, faint spangle/streak on frame faces and blade skin) so no galvanized surface is uniform.

Raise the shadow floor slightly (hemisphere/fill or env intensity on the dark side) so the two counter-rotated blades, EPDM bulbs, and black plastic clamp/strap separate from black — EPDM should read matte dark grey-black with a wide dim sheen, not a void.
Carried: remove the stray dashed diagonal line geometry near the frame's lower-right corner (still visible near the strap foot and across the floor).
Carried: mirror the crank-arm tilts by blade sign — blades 1 and 3 (+theta) cranks share one arm angle, blade 2 (-theta) opposed, recomputed from the actual blade angle at any apertura.
Carried (partial): finish lifting the jamb seal strips proud of the interior side faces (or lighten the interior) so the upper jamb strips read as parts, not shade.
